notes.title: [A Street Cat's Tale 2] 1.0.0.14 Update
notes.content:
There was a bug in the previous version of the game that prevented the complete retrieval of save data. This bug has been fixed in the 1.0.0.14 version.



[b]Bug details:[/b]

-Issue with store unlocking, upgrades, and tutorial being reset.

-Issue with the previous save file's progress being lost after reaching an ending.



[i][b]Note: [/b]If you had unlocked any stores, upgraded from Jimmy, or completed any endings in the play data of versions prior to 1.0.0.14, there might have been data corruption. To ensure normal operation, please proceed with unlocking, upgrading, and completing endings again within the save file starting from version 1.0.0.14 onwards.[/i]
